conservation.comparison: Complete members, exact C01 canonical intent/result bytes, blob bytes, pins, tombstones, policies and lineage

acceptanceMatrix: F01-F35 and F37-F40 qualification proof complete; F36 extracted-kit proof belongs to M09.06.
limits: Synthetic Windows amd64/local NTFS and loopback qualification.
Controlled clients, direct fixture preparation and injected barriers/faults are identified separately from ordinary browser/CLI journeys.
Earlier slice evidence is reused only with relevant-source equality or superseded by final-candidate reruns.
The browser inventory original wrapper failure is retained. It incorrectly rejected valid diagnostic events and the same saved evidence was independently revalidated.
The existing inventory contains one unclassified LOCAL console event. Each of five large-label/pagination browser runs also contains one unclassified sanitized console event; functional checks pass.

The admitted file-read snapshot is proven complete before detach commits. Native DELETE-journal locking prevents the test from forcing Read return after detach commit. Export delivery after detach is separately proven.
F40 hydration uses three observation-only calls in a private source overlay. It measures calls and candidate counts, not heap usage.

Original comparison uses exact C01 canonical intent/result bytes under the archive contract. Archive formatting can change raw stored JSON whitespace. The physical 10-to-11 upgrade separately preserves raw row bytes.
Physical power-loss behavior was not tested.
The fresh extracted-kit demonstration and final delivery review belong to M09.06.
